title: Metrizable and Fréchet--Urysohn subgroups and linear subspaces of topological vector spaces
summary: For a normed space $E$, we denote by $E_w$ and $E'_{w^*}$ the space $E$ and its dual $E'$ endowed with the weak topology $w$ and the weak$^*$ topology $w^*$, respectively. It is well known that for a Banach space $E$, both spaces $E_w$ and $E'_{w^*}$ are Fréchet--Urysohn topological spaces if and only if $E$ is finite-dimensional. This statement remains true for all linear subspaces of $E_w$ and $E'_{w^*}$.
